verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a documented public Developer API. A live probe confirmed a 174-path OpenAPI schema, and the docs cover OAuth 2.0 client-credentials and auth-code flows with granular resource:permission scopes. Documented endpoints include transactions, bills (POST /bills), virtual cards via Vault, custom records and AI usage, plus a sandbox API base and machine-readable llms.txt/llms-api.txt references for agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actual authenticated API calls (probes only verified the schema and docs exist), and some sensitive endpoints such as the Vault API are gated behind Ramp approval.
